_meta.description: Comprehensive design system guide for the Yahoo Partner Portal prototype. This is the single source of truth for all UI decisions. Always consult this file before creating any component, icon, pattern, or styling.
_meta.figmaLibraryRef: See design/figma-library.json for all Figma node IDs

platformsDesignSystem.name: Platforms Design System
platformsDesignSystem.description: Additional Yahoo UDS reference for tokens and patterns

designPrinciples.tone: Enterprise-grade clarity and trustworthiness for B2B partner users
designPrinciples.hierarchy: Information-dense layouts that remain scannable under load
designPrinciples.colorPhilosophy: Neutral, product-centric, restrained color usage. Status color is reserved strictly for semantic meaning.
designPrinciples.consistency: Every interactive element must map to a known UDS or portal-defined component pattern
designPrinciples.simplicity: Functional over flashy — emphasis on typography and spacing over decoration
rules: Never use one-off colors; always reference the color token table below
Never create a new component without first checking if it already exists in src/components/ or @yahoo/uds
Always use Yahoo Product Sans VF as the default body/UI font
Always check design/figma-library.json for the icon name before using lucide-react or other icon libraries
Always use @yahoo/uds-icons package for icons — never import from lucide-react for UI icons

tokens._source: Extracted from @yahoo/uds Tailwind plugin and Figma Pagination component (node 159:62223, fileKey 4KQB7uUMehkWVMXaFbGrMK)

typography._source: Yahoo Product Sans VF variable font + Figma token vars

fonts.primary: Yahoo_Product_Sans_VF (variable) — use for all UI text, labels, body
fonts.display: Yahoo Sans — use for marketing-style headings if needed
fonts.mono: system monospace — for code/preformatted text only

label1.use: Form labels, filter chip text, tab labels

label2.use: Body text, table content, dropdown items

kpiValue.font: Yahoo CR3 VAR BETA Bold (Yahoo_Product_Sans_VF, font-bold)

radii.full: 9999px — pill-shaped filter chips, icon buttons, avatar circles

components._howToFetch: For any component below: use Figma MCP get_design_context(nodeId=<nodeId>, fileKey=<fileKey>) to get full spec and Tailwind code. Node IDs are in design/figma-library.json.

AppShell.description: Top-level chrome: sidebar (252px) + header (64px) + scrollable content area

GlobalHeader.description: 64px white header bar with Yahoo logo, search, and profile dropdown
GlobalHeader.dimensions: h-16 (64px), full width of content column

elements.logoButton: Purple circular icon button, size-11 (44px), bg-[#7d2eff]

Sidebar.description: 252px collapsible sidebar with multi-level navigation, business search, and active state indicator
Sidebar.navRowHeight: py-3.5 px-5 (active state has 3px left bar in brand purple)

PageHeader.description: Reusable page header with optional breadcrumbs, title row, optional actions slot, optional filter row
structure: Title row: 24px bold (28px lh) left-aligned; optional primary button + icon button right-aligned with gap-3

KpiCard.description: KPI metric tile with value, delta badge, and optional sparkline

primary.description: Large tile with sparkline — used in top 2-col row of Overview

secondary.description: Compact tile without sparkline — used in 3-col secondary grid

KpiCard.cardStyle: rounded-[8px] border border-[#f0f3f5] bg-white shadow-[0px_1px_2px_rgba(31,31,31,0.05)] hover:border-[#e0e4e9] hover:shadow-[0px_1px_2px_rgba(31,31,31,0.05),0px_1px_4px_rgba(31,31,31,0.10)]

KpiSparkline.description: Mini ECharts line chart embedded in primary KpiCard
KpiSparkline.style: No axes, no grid, no labels. Dark line #232a31, 4px circle points. Client component.

Pagination.description: Full pagination bar: page-size selector + range display + first/prev/page-input/next/last navigation
Pagination.layout: flex row, px-8 py-4, gap-10 between sections
Pagination.spacing: 12px gap between nav buttons, 8px icon button spacing

FilterChip.description: Pill-shaped filter control. Two variants: applied (dark border) and dropdown (light border + chevron)

applied.description: Active filter with X icon to clear

dropdown.description: Opens a multi-select or date picker

FilterBar.description: Orchestrator for all filter chips — renders DateFilter and MultiSelectDropdown chips in a flex-wrap row

DateFilter.description: Date range filter chip. Presets auto-apply; Custom opens a 520px popover with date range + time + timezone + Save/Clear.

MultiSelectDropdown.description: Searchable multi-select dropdown with checkbox items. Auto-applies on click, no explicit Apply step.

MetricTabs.description: Horizontal tab strip for switching between metrics. Active tab has 4px underline in brand purple.
MetricTabs.style: text-[14px] font-medium, active: border-b-4 border-[#7d2eff], inactive: border-b-4 border-[#f0f3f5]
MetricTabs.gap: gap-6 between tabs, py-3 vertical padding

TablePagination.description: Table pagination component with show-rows dropdown, range label, and page navigation

RankedContentTable.description: 3-column compact table: Rank (49px fixed), Title (flex), Views (80px fixed)

BrandComparisonTable.description: 8-column sortable table with inline bar visualization for Views column

PublishStatusLabel.description: Semantic status badge with dot indicator and colored text/bg

DeltaArrowIcon.description: Custom SVG trend arrow (up/down/left/right). Used in KpiCard delta badges.
DeltaArrowIcon.preferFigmaIcon: Consider replacing with ArrowUp/ArrowDown from @yahoo/uds-icons for consistency

DownloadButton.description: Expandable download button with export format menu (CSV, XLSX, PDF)

ContentPerformanceChart.description: Full-width ECharts line chart with tooltips and click interaction
ContentPerformanceChart.style: rounded-[10px] bg-white px-3 py-6 h-[280px] border border-[#f0f3f5]

PerformancePublishingOutcomeCard.style: rounded-[16px] border border-[#e0e4e9] bg-white px-6 py-4

VideoCard.description: Tabbed video metrics card with ECharts line charts per metric

PublishingVitalsDetail.description: Large composite component for feed health: feeds table + issues table + charts

icons._source: Yahoo Icon Library (fileKey: hp6GgCsqpJ5dCeTmB43LPf). Full list in design/figma-library.json

usage.preferredSize: 16px for inline/table, 20px for navigation, 24px for feature icons
usage.preferredVariant: outline for UI chrome; fill for active/selected states; multicolor for weather/illustrations
usage.doNotUse: Never import from lucide-react or heroicons for icons that exist in @yahoo/uds-icons

appShell.sidebar: 252px fixed width, full viewport height, white bg, right border
appShell.header: 64px fixed height, full content-column width, white bg, bottom border
appShell.contentArea: Remaining space, scrollable, bg-[#f5f5f5], px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6

layout.pageMaxWidth: ~1100–1200px content width within the scrollable area

gridSystem.kpiPrimary: grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 (2 primary KPI cards)
gridSystem.kpiSecondary: grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 (3 secondary KPI cards)
gridSystem.overviewTwoCol: grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4 (performance chart + ranked table)

layout.cardSpacing: gap-4 (16px) between cards in a grid

contentPerformance.style: rounded-[10px] bg-white px-3 py-6 border border-[#f0f3f5]

stackedBar.style: rounded-[16px] border border-[#e0e4e9] bg-white px-6 py-4

interactions.hoverState: Subtle border darkening (#f0f3f5 → #e0e4e9) + slight shadow increase. Avoid large saturation jumps.
interactions.focusState: Visible outline ring aligned with UDS focus-ring tokens
interactions.dropdownDismiss: Click outside dismisses dropdown (useOnClickOutside hook in src/lib/useOnClickOutside.ts)
interactions.linkStyle: underline, text-[#6e7780] or text-[#464e56], hover opacity-80

statusBadge.description: Pill badge with dot indicator and semantic color
statusBadge.structure: inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[12px]

sectionCard.description: Standard white card wrapping a content section

tableWrapper.description: Overflow scroll wrapper for wide tables

microLabel.description: Small uppercase label used above section headings

inlineBar.description: Inline data visualization bar within a table cell

accessibility.ariaLabels: All interactive elements must have aria-label or aria-labelledby
accessibility.disabledState: opacity-20 on nav buttons at first/last page (matching Figma spec)
accessibility.focusManagement: Trap focus in dropdowns/modals; restore focus on close
